packs.name: Cyberbase Actual Structure
packs.description: Rule pack for actual Cyberbase vault structure with emoji-controlled sorting, Johnny Decimal OUTPUT folders, and optional entity support for testing multi-user scenarios.
packs.author: Cybersader

packs.name: Johnny Decimal
packs.description: Numeric two-digit prefixes per sibling at each depth. Each numbered area maps identity-style to tags, preserving the prefix.
packs.author: Cybersader

establish.summary: Numbered top-level areas (10-, 20-, …, 90-). Each area can subdivide further with two-digit numeric prefixes.

packs.name: PARA
packs.description: Tiago Forte's PARA method — four canonical Work buckets: Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive. Identity transfer between folder hierarchy and tag hierarchy.
packs.author: Cybersader

establish.summary: Four top-level Work folders: active Projects, ongoing Areas of responsibility, reference Resources, and Archive.

packs.name: SEACOW(r) Cyberbase Structure
packs.description: Rule pack for SEACOW(r) framework: System, Entity, Activities (Capture, Output, Work, relation). Syncs tags to folders while preserving the knowledge organization meta-framework.
packs.author: Cybersader

packs.name: SEACOW outer shell
packs.description: Just the SEACOW outer structure — Capture, Entity, Output, System — without committing to specific inner systems. Compose with PARA, Johnny Decimal, or Zettelkasten packs to fill the inner axes.
packs.author: Cybersader

establish.summary: Lays down the four SEACOW outer roots — Capture, Entity, Output, System — with conventional sub-folders. Pick component packs (PARA, JD, etc.) to fill the inner axes.

packs.name: Path Lens templates — demo
packs.description: Demonstration pack showing each Path Lens shape — identity, glob, filters, and convention-tolerant variants for emoji-prefixed and Johnny-Decimal-prefixed folder names. Use as a copy-paste reference when authoring template-shaped rules.
packs.author: Cybersader

establish.summary: Three folders demonstrating identity (Projects), filter chain (Areas with kebab-case), and marker-only-via-glob (Capture/Inbox).
